BEFORE THE ADJUDICATING OFFICER

SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE BOARD OF INDIA, MUMBAI

ORDER NO: ADJ/2024-25/SEBI/WRO/11048

IN THE MATTER OF ADJUDICATION PROCEEDINGS IN RESPECT OF:

  1. Zenith Birla (India) Limited (PAN: AABCZ1234K)
  2. Shri Arvind Shenoy (Director & Noticee)
  3. Quant Capital Wealth Managers LLP (Intermediary Noticee)

I. BACKGROUND & ALLEGATIONS

1. The Securities and Exchange Board of India (hereinafter referred to as “SEBI”) conducted an investigation into trading activities in the GDR issue manipulation and illiquid stock options segment at BSE.

2. The investigation revealed that Zenith Birla (India) Limited along with its managing director Shri Arvind Shenoy engaged in misleading representations and entered into synchronized trading arrangements violating Regulations 3(a), (b), (c), (d), 4(1), and 4(2)(a) of SEBI (Prohibition of Fraudulent and Unfair Trade Practices relating to Securities Market) Regulations, 2003 (“PFUTP Regulations”).

II. FINDINGS AND ASSESSMENT

3. A Show Cause Notice (“SCN”) dated October 12, 2023 was issued to the Noticees under Rule 4(1) of the SEBI Adjudication Rules. The noticees submitted their written replies and availed personal hearings before the Adjudicating Officer in Mumbai.

4. After considering the material available on record, I find that the violations of Section 12A of SEBI Act, 1992 and PFUTP Regulations stand established against Zenith Birla (India) Limited and Shri Arvind Shenoy.

III. ORDER AND PENALTY

5. Therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred upon me under Section 15-I of the SEBI Act, 1992 read with Rule 5 of the Adjudication Rules, 1995, I hereby impose a penalty of Rs. 1,50,00,000/- (Rupees One Crore Fifty Lakhs only) on the Noticees under Section 15HA of the SEBI Act, 1992.

6. The Noticees shall remit the monetary penalty amount within forty-five (45) days of receipt of this order by way of online payment through SEBI payment gateway.

Date: April 02, 2024

Place: Mumbai, Maharashtra

Adjudicating Officer: Member (Enforcement)
